title: Audit Kernel Module Disable and Denylist
description: Audit a kernel module on a Linux host: if the module exists, verify it is not loaded, has an install disable with /bin/true or /bin/false, and is denylisted in modprobe config; otherwise pass.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Hostname or IP of the target Linux server to audit.

parameters.name: kernel_module_name
parameters.description: Name of the kernel module to audit (default: cramfs).

fields.name: result
fields.description: Overall audit result: PASS if the module is properly disabled/denylisted or does not exist, FAIL otherwise.

steps.name: Find kernel module files
steps.function: Search /lib/modules for any .ko files belonging to the specified module (default fs type) to determine if the module exists.

steps.name: Does the module exist?
steps.function: Branch based on whether any module .ko files were found.
steps.condition: The kernel module exists on the system (at least one .ko file found).

steps.name: Check install disable line
steps.function: Run modprobe --showconfig and grep for an install line with /bin/true or /bin/false for the module. The task must not fail if grep finds nothing (use failed_when: false).

steps.name: Check blacklist line
steps.function: Run modprobe --showconfig and grep for a blacklist line for the module. The task must not fail if grep finds nothing (use failed_when: false).

steps.name: Check if module is loaded
steps.function: Run lsmod and grep for the module name (whole word). The task must not fail if grep finds nothing (use failed_when: false).

steps.name: Determine overall audit result
steps.function: Evaluate the three checks: install disable exists (exit code 0), blacklist exists (exit code 0), module not loaded (exit code not 0). Set final result to PASS if all three are true, else FAIL.

steps.name: Set result to PASS (module not present)
steps.function: When the module does not exist on the system, set the audit result to PASS.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.
steps.error_message: ERROR: Audit failed due to an unexpected error. Please check the Ansible output for details.

phases.name: Module Existence Verification
phases.description: Check whether the kernel module files exist on the target host.

phases.name: Compliance Checks
phases.description: If the module exists, verify install disable, denylist, and load state.

phases.name: Result Compilation and Reporting
phases.description: Compute the overall audit result and emit the final PASS/FAIL output.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
